body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG presented its WiBro PDA handset ''KC1'' during CES 2007. It supports WiBro, CDMA EV-DO, T-DMB, Bluetooth connectivity. Users have an option to choose WiFi as well.
It runs Windows Mobile 5.0 PPC Premium OS and features Monahans 806MHz CPU.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
